title: pi-immunity config
description: Safety extension config. Shape is stable as of the 2025-08 rework; $schema entries are not written yet (added once the shape stabilizes).

strict.description: LLM unavailable AND no rule match → prompt the user (true) or allow (false).

kind.description: directory = recursive (the directory and all descendants)

path.description: No globs. ~ allowed. Relative must start with ./

exact.description: true → full-string match; false (default) → substring match

raw.description: Fed into the LLM prompt as policy

regex.description: Deterministic-only fallback matcher; never fed to the LLM

promptWhen.description: asked: only ask-rules prompt (LLM DENY blocks silently). blocked: asks and blocks prompt. everytime: prompt after every verdict (debugging).

disabled.description: Opt-out: the analysis layer is enabled unless disabled

userPrompt.description: User-authored policy text appended to the analyzer system prompt

piPath.description: pi binary for the headless analyzer subprocess (default: pi on PATH)

afterPrompt.description: Bash command run right before an approval prompt opens (context via IMMUNITY_* env vars)
